data.title: Top 3 Price Prediction: Bitcoin, Ethereum, Ripple – BTC extends gains, ETH and XRP advance in uptrend | FXStreet
data.description: Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH) and Ripple (XRP) extend their gains on Monday after posting strong gains of over 5%, 6% and 5%, respectively, last week. BTC trades above $81,300, ETH climbs above $2,600, and XRP holds above the key $1.300 support level.
